name: Halcyon
tagline: Intraday option selling on NSE stocks
summary: Halcyon sells one stock option on each signal across 46 NSE stocks: a put when Firefly's rules turn up, a call when they turn down. Positions are opened during the session and almost always closed the same day, on a trend reversal, a stop or the end of the day.
risk: Every position is a short option with no hedge, so the loss on a trade is not capped. Selling options needs exchange margin far above the premium received: at its busiest this backtest held 44 short positions on about ₹2.9 crore of stock at once. Results are before brokerage, taxes and slippage.
